title: A Regiment for the Bridge
author: Dominic Crane
blurb: Elodie Thackeray, a mapmaker's apprentice finishing the atlas the master died for, keeps a low profile and busy hands. But when a stranger arrives carrying unmistakable handwriting from a supposed corpse, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must finish the work while the workshop still stands, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
